questions.question: Duare Ration Scheme, which has been deemed legally void by the high court, was launched by which of the following states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Duare Ration Scheme** was launched by the state government of **West Bengal** in 2021.
 
• The initiative aimed to deliver food grains and other ration materials directly to the doorstep of beneficiaries under the Public Distribution System (PDS).
 
• It was part of the state government’s efforts to improve the accessibility of essential goods for economically weaker sections.
 
• The scheme was declared legally void by the Calcutta High Court in 2022, citing that it overlapped with the central government’s National Food Security Act (NFSA).
 
• The ruling highlighted that states do not have the authority to modify or create parallel schemes that conflict with central legislation like the NFSA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013:**

 
 
• The NFSA provides subsidized food grains to approximately two-thirds of India’s population.
 
• It is a central government initiative aimed at ensuring food security for economically weaker sections.
 
• The Act covers priority households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) beneficiaries.
 
• Under the Act, eligible households receive 5 kg of food grains per person per month at highly subsidized rates.
 
 
 
• **Public Distribution System (PDS):**
 
 
• PDS is a government-managed system that distributes essential commodities like rice, wheat, and sugar to eligible beneficiaries.
 
• It aims to ensure food security and mitigate hunger, especially for low-income families.
 
• PDS operates through a network of Fair Price Shops (FPS) across the country.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal's Welfare Initiatives:**
 
 
• West Bengal has implemented several welfare schemes, including 'Khadya Sathi,' which provides subsidized food grains to 90% of the state’s population.
 
• The state government has also focused on doorstep delivery schemes like 'Duare Sarkar' to improve service accessibility.
 
 
 
• **Legal Conflict in Duare Ration Scheme:**
 
 
• The High Court ruled that the scheme conflicted with the central NFSA and lacked legal authority under the federal structure.
 
• The ruling emphasized that food distribution policies fall under the central government’s purview in India.

questions.question: In which year did the Government of India pass the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** was passed by the **Government of India** in the year **2005**.
 
• It aims to enhance the livelihood security of people in **rural areas** by guaranteeing at least **100 days of wage-employment** in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• MGNREGA is a social security measure that provides a legal guarantee for employment.
 
• The Act was passed under the leadership of the then Prime Minister, **Dr. Manmohan Singh**, and was a significant step towards poverty alleviation.
 
• It is considered one of the largest and most ambitious social welfare programs in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• MGNREGA is monitored by the **Ministry of Rural Development**, Government of India.
 
• The Act has provisions for ensuring **transparency and accountability** in the implementation of the scheme.
 
• It involves the **Gram Panchayats** in planning and implementing the works.
 
• Funds for the scheme are shared between the Central and State Governments.

questions.question: In which of the followings years was the National Population Policy of India released?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Population Policy (NPP) of India was **released in the year 2000**.
 
• The policy aimed to address the unmet needs for contraception, healthcare infrastructure, and health personnel, and to provide integrated service delivery for basic reproductive and child health care.
 
• One of the key goals of the NPP 2000 was to achieve a **stable population by 2045**, consistent with the requirements of sustainable economic growth, social development, and environmental protection.
 
• The policy emphasized the need for **universal access to quality health care** and education, and it included strategies to promote delayed marriage and childbearing and to ensure child survival.
 
• It also set specific targets, such as reducing the Total Fertility Rate (TFR) to **replacement levels by 2010** and achieving universal immunization of children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Health Policy 2017**

 
 
• The policy aims to achieve the highest possible level of health and well-being for all ages, through a preventive and promotive health care orientation in all developmental policies, and universal access to good quality health care services without anyone having to face financial hardship as a consequence.
 
• It also seeks to increase the life expectancy at birth from 67.5 to 70 by 2025.
 
• It emphasizes preventive healthcare, universal access to quality health services, and reducing out-of-pocket expenses for healthcare.
 
 
 
• **Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health (RMNCH+A) Strategy**
 
 
• This approach focuses on providing comprehensive care at all stages of life, starting from adolescence to childhood, reproductive age, pregnancy, and childbirth.
 
• It aims to reduce maternal and child mortality and improve the health and nutritional status of women and children.
 
 
 
• **Mission Indradhanush**
 
 
• Launched in December 2014, it aims to cover all those children who are either unvaccinated or are partially vaccinated against vaccine-preventable diseases.
 
• The mission focuses on improving immunization coverage and ensuring that children receive life-saving vaccines.
 
 
 
• **Total Fertility Rate (TFR)**
 
 
• It refers to the average number of children that would be born to a woman over her lifetime.
 
• Replacement level fertility is typically around 2.1 children per woman.
 
• Achieving a TFR of 2.1 is essential for population stabilization.

questions.question: iGOT Karmayogi is an integrated online training platform to provide continuous learning opportunities to ______________ in order to upgrade their skills.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Individual Civil Service Officials**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The iGOT Karmayogi platform is an **integrated online training platform** launched by the Government of India for continuous training and upskilling of civil service officials.
 
• It is part of the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (**NPCSCB**) aimed at upgrading the skills of government employees.
 
• The platform provides curated content on various subjects such as **public administration, ethics, governance, and management**, among others.
 
• It supports a competency-driven framework for training, ensuring officials meet evolving governance challenges.
 
• The platform aims to create a “citizen-centric and future-ready civil service” through **accessible and scalable digital learning solutions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB):**

 
 
• Launched in 2020, NPCSCB aims to transform capacity building in civil services through a comprehensive reform initiative.
 
• It focuses on **competency-based learning** and performance management.
 
• The programme emphasizes the use of digital platforms for scalable and personalized learning opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Karmayogi Bharat:**
 
 
• Karmayogi Bharat is a special purpose vehicle (SPV) set up to implement the iGOT Karmayogi platform.
 
• It is responsible for content curation, platform management, and integrating learning frameworks.
 
 
 
• **Competency Framework:**
 
 
• The iGOT platform follows a competency-driven approach, where roles and required skills are clearly mapped.
 
• This framework ensures that civil servants are equipped with the right knowledge and tools for effective governance.
 
 
 
• **Capacity Building Commission:**
 
 
• The Capacity Building Commission (CBC) was established under NPCSCB to monitor and evaluate training standards and effectiveness.
 
• The CBC ensures alignment of training programs with the mission’s goals.

questions.question: __________ was launched by the Government of India in 2020 to make the country and its citizens independent and self-sufficient in all respects.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan was launched by the Government of India in **May 2020** to make the country and its citizens self-reliant.
 
• This initiative aims to provide a stimulus package of **INR 20 lakh crore**, which is equivalent to 10% of India's GDP.
 
• The Abhiyan focuses on five main pillars: Economy, Infrastructure, System, Vibrant Demography, and Demand.
 
• The goal is to promote local manufacturing, boost local markets, and reduce dependence on imports.
 
• The package covers various sectors, including MSMEs, agriculture, and public health, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MSME Sector**

 
 
• Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) are the backbone of the Indian economy, contributing significantly to GDP and employment.
 
• Under Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan, the government announced collateral-free automatic loans worth INR 3 lakh crore for MSMEs.
 
• The initiative also includes a Fund of Funds with a corpus of INR 10,000 crore to provide equity funding for MSMEs.
 
• Revised definition of MSMEs to include larger enterprises and allow them to take advantage of the schemes.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture Sector**
 
 
• The package includes INR 1 lakh crore for the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund for farm-gate infrastructure for farmers.
 
• The government also announced INR 20,000 crore for the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to develop marine and inland fisheries.
 
• Reforms to amend the Essential Commodities Act and promote barrier-free inter-state trade of agricultural products.
 
• Focus on improving storage and logistics to reduce post-harvest losses.
 
 
 
• **Public Health**
 
 
• The package allocates INR 15,000 crore to strengthen public health infrastructure in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Emphasis on ramping up testing facilities, creating additional hospital beds, and ensuring the availability of essential medical supplies.
 
• Enhanced focus on research and development of vaccines and treatments for COVID-19.
 
• Support for states to improve their healthcare systems and prepare for future health crises.

questions.question: In which city, Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission is one of the biggest health schemes for healthcare in India which was launched on 25th October 2021.**

 
 
• It was announced in the Union budget 2021-22 with an outlay of 64, 180 crores.
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched this mission in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. Hence option 4 is correct.**
 
• It aims to strengthen public healthcare institutions to deliver primary healthcare and its related services like diagnosis and treatment.
 
• **To build an IT-enabled disease surveillance system by developing a network of laboratories at the regional level, district level and national levels.**
 
• Research on Covid-19 and other infections is to be taken to develop core facilities to deliver the one health approach to prevent, detect and treatment of infections.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This mission consists of Centrally Sponsered Scheme and other components like **Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres in Rural areas (AB-HWCs)**, Urban areas, Block Public Health Units, Integrated District Public Health Laboratories etc.
 
• **AB-HWCs are proposed for 7 high focus states which include Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal.**
 
 
• North Eastern states included in the list are Assam, Manipur and Meghalaya.
 
 
 
• Integrated District Public Health Labs are to be included in all the districts and **Critical Care Hospitals are added in districts where the population is more than 5 lakhs.**
